title: Ruby professional-practice assessment blueprint
scope: Synthesize core language skills and selected professional practices. Questions are draft and require subject-matter review before publication.
suggested_attempt_policy: Use the platform-configured assessment attempt policy; do not implement attempt enforcement in course content.
learning_outcomes: Reason about Ruby syntax, values, collections, methods, and object behavior.
Select appropriate errors, I/O, dependencies, and tests.
Recognize security, concurrency, database, web, deployment, and version-sensitive risks.
remediation_policy: Use missed outcomes to recommend targeted lesson review and relevant exercises. The course file does not itself issue certificates or enforce attempts.
certificate_policy: Certificate issuance remains pending until CodeLeaf verifies a passing result server-side through its actual exam implementation.
